messages:
IncidentBot: PAGER: P1 - Increased generation latency detected in eu-central. Affected endpoints: /v1/generate, /v1/chat. Pager routed to @Elena. Incident ID: INC-20260317-01

Elena: Oncall Elena — I'm looking. I see genqueue backlog and elevated latency in genpool-eu-3.

Mike: Thanks — can you estimate customer impact so we can get an initial public update out?

Elena: Quick read: ~12% of requests in eu-central experiencing >5s tail latency. Error rate is near baseline. Investigating autoscaler behaviour and queued jobs.

Priya: I'll draft a short status update. Target sections: what happened, who is impacted, current status, mitigation steps, ETA for next update.

Carmen: @Priya share the draft here. Ops needs timeline + what changes we plan to make.

Priya: ```
DRAFT STATUS PAGE COPY:

We are currently investigating increased latencies for text generation requests in eu-central. A subset of customers may experience slower responses or intermittent failures. Our engineers are actively mitigating the issue and will provide updates every 30 minutes.

Impact: Some requests to generation endpoints may have higher latency or fail intermittently.

Mitigation: We are scaling additional GPU workers and rebalancing queued requests.

Workaround: Retry requests or route to another region if possible.

Status: Under investigation — engineers are working on mitigation.
```

Legal: Keep it high-level. Do NOT say 'root cause' or assert timeouts until confirmed. Remove words that imply data loss.

Priya: Updated per legal.```
PUBLIC DRAFT:

We are investigating an issue affecting generation latency in eu-central. Some customers may see delayed responses. Our team is actively working to mitigate the impact and will provide updates every 30 minutes.

Current status: Mitigation in progress (scaling and traffic rebalancing).
```

Elena: Mitigation progress: added 4 workers to genpool-eu-3 and restarted genqueue manager. KV cache intact. Recent checks show tail latency down from ~5.6s to ~1.4s. Error rate returned to baseline. Continuing to monitor.

Mike: Can we publish the 'Current status' text as the initial status update now? OpsLead, approve to publish? :eyes: :thumbsup: 

OpsLead: Approve for publish. Add ETA for next update and an 'Affected services' bullet list.

Priya: Final publish copy below.```
INITIAL UPDATE (publish):

We are investigating increased latency for generation requests in eu-central. A subset of requests may experience delayed responses. Our engineers are mitigating the issue by scaling capacity and rebalancing traffic.

Affected services: Generation and chat endpoints in eu-central.

Current status: Mitigation in progress — latency improving after scaling actions. We will post another update by 15:20 UTC.

If you are experiencing issues, please contact support.
```

Samir: Publishing now. cc @Elena for post-publish monitoring.

IncidentBot: Statuspage: Initial update posted to https://incidents.redwood.ai/INC-20260317-01 (initial).

Elena: Monitoring metrics — looks stable so far. Will hold a 20m watch window and post resolved notice if no regressions.

Carmen: Nice. Elena, please paste exact scaling commands for the internal post-incident note.

Elena: ```
Commands run:

kubectl scale deployment/genpool-eu-3 --replicas=6 --namespace=redwood-inference
kubectl rollout restart deployment/genqueue-manager -n redwood-inference
# trimmed queued keys rather than full flush:
redis-cli -h kv-eu eval "local k=KEYS[1]; redis.call('ltrim', k, 0, 1000)" 1 queued_jobs_key
```

Priya: Internal ops note draft:```
INTERNAL: Scaled genpool-eu-3 and restarted genqueue-manager. Trimmed queued job list. No customer data exposure. Monitoring ongoing for 20 minutes before marking resolved.
```

Legal: Looks good. Save copies in the incident folder and flag for post-mortem.

Elena: 20m passed with no regressions. Drafting resolved notice.```
RESOLVED DRAFT:

The increased generation latency affecting eu-central has been mitigated. Engineers scaled capacity and rebalanced traffic; services are operating within normal latency ranges. We will continue to monitor and follow up if further action is required.
```

Mike: LGTM — publish resolved. :tada:

IncidentBot: Statuspage: Resolved notice posted to https://incidents.redwood.ai/INC-20260317-01 (resolved).

Priya: Closing thread. Action items for post-incident retro: review autoscaler thresholds, add protection for noisy batch jobs, verify alert thresholds for tail latency.

Elena: Thanks team. I'll file the follow-up doc and sched a retro. ``
